name: Witch Hunter Stake keeps its health gate and drops the legacy 680548 trigger with the 22/11 client flags
contract: Stake 680537 and rank 681347 read 'Only usable on enemies at or below 35% health.' The 22/11 Spell.dbc gives
Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, DmgClass Melee, SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON
(EquippedItemClass 2, EquippedItemSubClassMask 41105) and ManaCostPercentage 12; 681347 also has Effect[1]
TRIGGER_SPELL 680548, a caster PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL aura of Flames of Sin 803710 every 100 ms.
ApplyAscensionWitchHunterStakeContracts accepts the (8,0,1024) flags, clears TargetAuraState and removes
Effect[1], so the bound spell_ascension_witch_hunter_stake CheckCast (-680537 chain) returns
SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE (111) above 35% health. Item 37 is a main-hand one-handed axe (Item.dbc class 2,
subclass 0). Expected: each rank is refused with 111 and deals no damage at 40% health and lands once at 30%;
after 681347 lands, the hunter never casts 680548 and neither unit holds it. Maximal melee hit and expertise
remove miss, dodge and parry from the landing assertions.
